_about: The AI apps' marks shown in Agents → AI apps, in Connect and as agents' avatars. The marks belong to their owners; Antenna uses them only to identify an integration, small, with no endorsement implied. Checked 2026-10-03; details and quotes of each vendor's guidelines in docs/CONNECT-APPS.md, "Marks". build.py turns this file and the SVGs next to it into lib/theme/ai_logos.dart.

brands.name: OpenAI (ChatGPT, Codex)
brands.why_none: Simple Icons removed the OpenAI mark in 16.0.0 (2025-11-30) because OpenAI's terms grant only a non-transferable licence; openai.com/brand could not be read (403). Monogram until OpenAI's terms are confirmed for this use.

brands.name: Claude (Anthropic)
brands.license: Simple Icons SVG data CC0-1.0; the mark is Anthropic's trademark. Anthropic publishes the mark in its press kit (https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit); no third-party usage terms were found.

brands.name: Claude Code (Anthropic)
brands.license: Simple Icons SVG data CC0-1.0; the mark is Anthropic's trademark (press kit: https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit, "Claude Code logo"); no third-party usage terms were found.

brands.name: Google Gemini
brands.why_none: Google product icons are "Ask first": permission through the Partner Marketing Hub (https://about.google/brand-resource-center/guidance/). Monogram.

brands.name: Cursor (Anysphere)
brands.license: Simple Icons SVG data CC0-1.0; the mark is Anysphere's trademark. cursor.com/brand offers the icon in light and dark; no third-party usage terms were found.

brands.name: VS Code with GitHub Copilot
brands.why_none: Microsoft does not allow the VS Code icon to identify another product (https://code.visualstudio.com/brand), and Simple Icons removed it in 13.0.0 at Microsoft's request; GitHub Copilot has had no standalone logo since 2025 (https://github.com/logos). Monogram.

brands.name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
brands.why_none: Windsurf's guidelines ask for a mockup for any use they do not cover (https://windsurf.com/brand), and the app is now Devin Desktop, which has no mark in Simple Icons. Monogram.

brands.name: Zed (Zed Industries)
brands.license: Simple Icons SVG data CC0-1.0; the mark is Zed Industries' trademark. zed.dev/brand: only brand blue (#1348DC), white or black, and no use that could imply an official connection or endorsement.

brands.name: LM Studio (Element Labs)
brands.license: Simple Icons SVG data CC0-1.0; the mark is LM Studio's trademark. lmstudio.ai/brand: use the logo when referring to LM Studio, no implied sponsorship or endorsement, do not recolour (black, white or the colour versions).

brands.name: Grok (xAI)
brands.why_none: No xAI or Grok mark in Simple Icons; xAI's guidelines require marks exactly as provided and say only xAI may grant use (https://x.ai/legal/brand-guidelines). Monogram.
